id: 10_MOOC INTRODUCTION TO BIORISK MANAGEMENT SAMPLE HANDLING
title: 医院样本的接收与处理
source_doc: course/BIORISK MANAGEMENT/10_MOOC INTRODUCTION TO BIORISK MANAGEMENT SAMPLE HANDLING.md
author_source: project/BIORISK MANAGEMENT/10_MOOC INTRODUCTION TO BIORISK MANAGEMENT SAMPLE HANDLING/src.py

points.K2: 已知培养物，风险好评估
points.K3: 病人样本，可能不止一种病原
points.K4: 医院样本，往高处估风险
points.K10: 要培养的样本：最严防护
points.S1: 不合格样本：拒收并记录
points.S3: 灭活要验证，标识后出柜
points.S4: 核酸检测分区，单向流动

shots.scene: 欣欣站在样本接收窗口旁，手里拿着一个黄色密封袋
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a sample reception window holding a sealed yellow bag and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天说说：医院送来的样本怎么接。
overlay: 医院样本的接收与处理

shots.scene: 保卫处值班员把一个保温箱交给阿杰
shots.prompt_en: The security officer hands an insulated transport box to the young male student at the laboratory door.
shots.narration: 阿杰第一次值班接收医院样本。

shots.scene: 阿杰抱着箱子，看着箱上的生物危害标志发愣
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds the box and stares uncertainly at the biohazard warning sign on its lid.
shots.narration: 这里面装的是什么？危险吗？

shots.scene: 小研戴好手套走过来，示意他把箱子放到指定台面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing gloves, walks over and gestures toward a marked reception bench.
shots.narration: 小研说：别急，一步一步来。

shots.scene: 多条箭头从医院、研究室、外单位图标汇向一个实验室
shots.prompt_en: Arrows from a hospital icon, a research lab icon and another institute icon converge on one laboratory icon. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室的样本，来自不同地方。

shots.scene: 实验室门上的三级生物安全标识图标
shots.prompt_en: A laboratory door icon marked with a biosafety level three pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 在高等级实验室，样本更要处理得当。

shots.section_title: 已知培养物，风险好评估
shots.scene: 一支标签清楚的培养物试管，旁边一张卡片画着已知病原和改造标记
shots.prompt_en: A neatly labeled culture tube beside a blank card showing one known microbe icon and a small gene edit icon. No people.
shots.narration: 研究人员送来的纯培养物，
overlay: 已知培养物，风险好评估

shots.section_title: 已知培养物，风险好评估
shots.scene: 卡片上打勾
shots.prompt_en: The card receives a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 是什么病原、改过什么，都清楚。

shots.section_title: 已知培养物，风险好评估
shots.scene: 天平图标稳定平衡
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale icon resting steady and even. No people.
shots.narration: 所以风险比较好评估。

shots.section_title: 病人样本，可能不止一种病原
shots.scene: 一排图标：拭子、血清管、血管、尿杯、粪便盒
shots.prompt_en: A row of icons: a swab, a serum tube, a blood tube, a urine cup and a stool container. No people.
shots.narration: 病人的样本就不一样了。
overlay: 病人样本，可能不止一种病原

shots.section_title: 病人样本，可能不止一种病原
shots.scene: 一支样本管里有几种不同形状的小病原
shots.prompt_en: A sample tube containing several different tiny microbe shapes. No people.
shots.narration: 一管样本里，可能有好几种病原。

shots.section_title: 病人样本，可能不止一种病原
shots.scene: 样本管上浮着一个问号
shots.prompt_en: A large question mark floating above the sample tube. No people.
shots.narration: 到底有什么，事先说不准。

shots.section_title: 医院样本，往高处估风险
shots.scene: 警示刻度表，指针指向高端
shots.prompt_en: A warning gauge with its needle pointing to the high end. No people.
shots.narration: 所以原片说：按最高可能的风险对待。
overlay: 医院样本，往高处估风险

shots.section_title: 医院样本，往高处估风险
shots.scene: 小研戴手套、穿防护服，小心拿着样本管
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in gloves and a lab gown handles a sample tube with care.
shots.narration: 在国内，先一律当作有传染性，

shots.section_title: 医院样本，往高处估风险
shots.scene: 王老师翻看空白的病原目录和风险评估表
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator reviews a blank pathogen catalogue book and a blank risk assessment form.
shots.narration: 再按病原目录和风险评估定级别。

shots.section_title: 医院样本，往高处估风险
shots.scene: 两排格子：左边第1格最浅，右边第一类最深，中间反转箭头
shots.prompt_en: Two rows of four boxes: on the left the first box is lightest, on the right the first box is darkest, with a reversing arrow between. No people.
shots.narration: 记住：国际1组最低，国内第一类最危险。

shots.scene: 黄色密封袋，袋口用扎带锁紧
shots.prompt_en: A sealed yellow plastic bag with its opening locked by a cable tie. No people.
shots.narration: 医院样本装在专用密封袋里，

shots.scene: 扎带特写，袋口封死
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the cable tie cinched tight around the bag opening. No people.
shots.narration: 袋口用扎带锁紧。

shots.scene: 密封袋放进保温箱，周围是冰袋和干冰块图标
shots.prompt_en: The sealed bag placed inside an insulated box surrounded by ice packs and a dry ice block icon. No people.
shots.narration: 再放进有冰袋或干冰的箱子运来。

shots.scene: 小研用消毒液喷洒、擦拭密封袋外表面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sprays and wipes the outside of the sealed bag with disinfectant on a reception tray.
shots.narration: 收到后，第一步：给外包装消毒。

shots.scene: 消毒液瓶旁一个计时器图标
shots.prompt_en: A disinfectant bottle next to a timer icon. No people.
shots.narration: 消毒要等够作用时间，

shots.scene: 规程卡上计时器打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank procedure card with the timer icon checked. No people.
shots.narration: 多久按本单位规程，别凭感觉。

shots.scene: 计时结束后，小研把袋子移进生物安全柜再打开
shots.prompt_en: After the timer ends, the female graduate student moves the bag into a biological safety cabinet and opens it inside.
shots.narration: 时间到了，在柜子里再开袋。

shots.scene: 柜内，小研从袋中取出一支红盖样本管
shots.prompt_en: Inside the biological safety cabinet, the female graduate student takes a red-capped sample tube out of the bag.
shots.narration: 取出样本管。

shots.scene: 样本管标签上的病人姓名被条码代替
shots.prompt_en: A tube label where the patient name area is replaced by a barcode. No people.
shots.narration: 这是病人样本，用编号代替姓名。

shots.scene: 手机拍照对着样本管，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A phone camera aimed at a sample tube label, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 病人信息不外传，不拍照。

shots.scene: 样本管管口缠着一小团白色纱布的特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a small wad of white gauze wrapped around the neck of the sample tube. No people.
shots.narration: 看，管口包着一小团纱布。

shots.scene: 柜内拧开管盖，一滴液体被纱布吸住
shots.prompt_en: Inside the cabinet, as the cap is loosened, a drop of liquid is soaked up by the gauze. No people.
shots.narration: 开管时滴下的液体，被它吸住。

shots.scene: 干净的手套特写，旁边小盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a clean gloved hand next to a small green shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 不沾手套，防护就不会被突破。

shots.scene: 医院里，老周给样本管贴空白标签、装袋
shots.prompt_en: In a hospital room, the older man labels a sample tube with a blank label and seals it in a bag.
shots.narration: 这些准备，在医院就要做好。

shots.scene: 标签和密封袋两个图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank label icon and a sealed bag icon, both with green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 标签贴清楚，包装封严实。

shots.scene: 运送人员图标和实验室人员图标头上各有一个盾牌
shots.prompt_en: Two person pictograms, a courier and a lab worker, each with a shield above the head. No people.
shots.narration: 保护路上的运送人，也保护实验室。

shots.section_title: 要培养的样本：最严防护
shots.scene: 样本到达后分出两条路线箭头
shots.prompt_en: An arrow from an arriving sample splits into two paths: one to a culture plate, one to a DNA helix. No people.
shots.narration: 进了实验室，样本分两种走法。
overlay: 要培养的样本：最严防护

shots.section_title: 要培养的样本：最严防护
shots.scene: 小研在柜内把样本接种到平板上
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student streaks a sample onto a culture plate inside the biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 一种是要培养病原的，

shots.section_title: 要培养的样本：最严防护
shots.scene: 平板上菌落变多，旁边警示图标升高
shots.prompt_en: Colonies multiply on a culture plate while a warning gauge beside it rises. No people.
shots.narration: 病原会越养越多，按活培养物评估。

shots.section_title: 要培养的样本：最严防护
shots.scene: 防护措施图标全部亮起
shots.prompt_en: A row of protective measure icons all lighting up: cabinet, gown, gloves, face shield. No people.
shots.narration: 防护措施要做到最严。

shots.scene: 另一条箭头指向核酸检测
shots.prompt_en: The second path arrow leads to a DNA helix and a test tube icon. No people.
shots.narration: 另一种是做核酸检测的，

shots.scene: 柜内一台加热模块，样本管插在孔里
shots.prompt_en: Sample tubes seated in a heating block inside the biological safety cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 先把样本灭活，让病原失去活性。

shots.scene: 加热模块旁一本空白规程，标着某病原图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank procedure book with a microbe icon on the cover beside the heating block. No people.
shots.narration: 怎么灭活，按该病原的操作规程。

shots.scene: 日历图标上写着过去的年份标记，旁边规程书
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon flipping back to an earlier year beside a blank procedure book. No people.
shots.narration: 原片的条件是当时做法，以现行规定为准。

shots.scene: 小研穿好防护在生物安全柜前操作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in gown, gloves and face shield works at a biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 这些步骤，都在生物安全柜里做，

shots.scene: 防护服、手套、面罩图标，旁边规程卡
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a gown, gloves and a face shield next to a blank procedure card. No people.
shots.narration: 穿好防护，按管理规定来。

shots.scene: 柜内，小研把灭活后的样本加到提取管里
shots.prompt_en: Inside the cabinet, the female graduate student adds an inactivated sample into extraction tubes.
shots.narration: 灭活后，提取核酸。

shots.scene: 提取操作仍在柜内，柜子图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: A biological safety cabinet icon with a green check mark over extraction tubes. No people.
shots.narration: 提取这一步，也要在柜里做。

shots.scene: 一台荧光定量 PCR 仪，机身空白
shots.prompt_en: A real-time thermal cycler instrument with a plain blank casing. No people.
shots.narration: 最后上荧光定量PCR仪检测，

shots.scene: 屏幕上一条上升的扩增曲线，屏幕无文字
shots.prompt_en: A screen showing a rising amplification curve with no text. No people.
shots.narration: 看样本里有没有目标病原。

shots.scene: 流程图：接收、开袋、灭活、提取、检测五个方框
shots.prompt_en: A flowchart of five blank boxes connected by arrows: reception, opening, inactivation, extraction, testing. No people.
shots.narration: 这一整套，要写进样本处理方案。

shots.scene: 每个方框上方一个小天平图标
shots.prompt_en: Small balance scale icons appear above each box in the flowchart. No people.
shots.narration: 每一步操作本身的风险，也要评估。

shots.scene: 王老师指着白板上的两个大方框：评估、控制
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at a whiteboard with two large blank boxes linked by an arrow, with a balance icon and a shield icon.
shots.narration: 回顾一下：先评估，再控制。

shots.scene: 医院样本图标指向高风险刻度
shots.prompt_en: A hospital sample icon pointing to the high end of a risk gauge. No people.
shots.narration: 医院样本，风险往高处估。

shots.scene: 实验室建筑和生物安全柜图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a containment laboratory building and a biological safety cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 工程控制：合适的实验室和安全柜。

shots.scene: 防护服、手套、面罩图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a gown, gloves and a face shield. No people.
shots.narration: 再加上个人防护。

shots.scene: 两支样本管：一支标签清楚，一支带问号，都被盾牌罩住
shots.prompt_en: Two tubes, one clearly labeled and one with a question mark, both covered by the same shield. No people.
shots.narration: 已知的、未知的样本，

shots.scene: 评估加控制两个图标连成一个圈
shots.prompt_en: A balance icon and a shield icon joined in a loop. No people.
shots.narration: 都按这个思路来管。

shots.section_title: 不合格样本：拒收并记录
shots.scene: 小研核对样本管条码和空白申请单
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student compares a tube barcode with a blank request form.
shots.narration: 接收时，先核对样本和申请单。
overlay: 不合格样本：拒收并记录

shots.section_title: 不合格样本：拒收并记录
shots.scene: 三个问题图标：无标签的管、管单不符、裂开的管
shots.prompt_en: Three problem icons: an unlabeled tube, a tube and form that do not match, and a cracked tube. No people.
shots.narration: 没标签、对不上、容器破损，

shots.section_title: 不合格样本：拒收并记录
shots.scene: 这类样本放进隔离盒，旁边登记本
shots.prompt_en: The problem sample placed into a separate holding box beside a blank logbook. No people.
shots.narration: 就拒收或单独隔离，并登记。

shots.section_title: 不合格样本：拒收并记录
shots.scene: 小研打电话联系送检方
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student calls the sending hospital on a desk phone.
shots.narration: 联系送检方，别自己猜着做。

shots.scene: 柜内样本管竖直放在架上静置
shots.prompt_en: A sample tube standing upright in a rack inside the cabinet, resting. No people.
shots.narration: 开盖前，先让管子静置一会儿。

shots.scene: 小研用沾消毒液的吸水纸裹住管盖
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wraps the tube cap with a disinfectant-soaked absorbent paper inside the cabinet.
shots.narration: 用沾了消毒液的纸巾包住管盖，

shots.scene: 管盖被缓慢拧开
shots.prompt_en: The wrapped cap is unscrewed slowly and gently. No people.
shots.narration: 慢慢拧开，不猛拔。

shots.scene: 甩管子和用力拔盖的图标，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a tube being flicked hard and a cap being yanked off, both crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 甩管、硬拔，都会溅出气溶胶。

shots.section_title: 灭活要验证，标识后出柜
shots.scene: 灭活后的样本管旁，一张空白验证报告
shots.prompt_en: Inactivated sample tubes beside a blank validation report with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 灭活方法要经过验证，确认有效。
overlay: 灭活要验证，标识后出柜

shots.section_title: 灭活要验证，标识后出柜
shots.scene: 小研给灭活后的样本管贴上空白彩色标签
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts blank colored labels on the inactivated tubes.
shots.narration: 灭活后的样本，贴上明显标识。

shots.section_title: 灭活要验证，标识后出柜
shots.scene: 样本架外壁被擦拭消毒后才移出柜子
shots.prompt_en: A sample rack being wiped with disinfectant before it is moved out of the cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 外壁消毒，确认后才移出柜子。

shots.section_title: 灭活要验证，标识后出柜
shots.scene: 未贴标识的管子被直接拿出柜子，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An unlabeled tube being carried straight out of the cabinet, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 没确认的，别拿出去。

shots.section_title: 核酸检测分区，单向流动
shots.scene: 四个房间图标连成一排
shots.prompt_en: Four room icons in a row connected by one-way arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 核酸检测实验室，分成几个区。
overlay: 核酸检测分区，单向流动

shots.section_title: 核酸检测分区，单向流动
shots.scene: 人员沿单向箭头前进，回头箭头被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram walks along the one-way arrows; a backward arrow is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 人和物品单向走，不走回头路。

shots.section_title: 核酸检测分区，单向流动
shots.scene: 每个房间门口挂着不同颜色的工作服
shots.prompt_en: Each room door has its own rack of lab coats in a different color. No people.
shots.narration: 各区的工作服和用品，不混用。

shots.section_title: 核酸检测分区，单向流动
shots.scene: 盾牌图标同时罩住人员和样本管
shots.prompt_en: A shield icon covering both a person pictogram and a sample tube. No people.
shots.narration: 既防污染结果，也保护人员。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现密封袋、消毒液、纱布样本管三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside three icons: a sealed bag, a disinfectant bottle and a tube with gauze.
shots.narration: 密封运来，外包装消毒，纱布防滴漏。

shots.scene: 核对单、隔离盒、包着纸巾的管盖图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a checklist, a holding box and a tube cap wrapped in paper. No people.
shots.narration: 核对样本，异常拒收，开盖要慢。

shots.scene: 两条路线箭头：培养和灭活，后面接生物安全柜
shots.prompt_en: Two path arrows, culture and inactivation, both leading into a biological safety cabinet icon. No people.
shots.narration: 要培养的最严防，做核酸的先灭活。

shots.scene: 天平和盾牌图标，旁边四个分区房间
shots.prompt_en: A balance icon and a shield icon beside four room icons with one-way arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 先评估再控制，分区单向走。

shots.scene: 欣欣抱着贴好标签的样本盒，向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a neatly labeled sample box and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 接好每一份样本，我们下次见！
